prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a large two-storey hall or inn in a walled academic city of scholars and astronomers. Blue-slate roof. Pale stone walls with tall arched windows, carved star ornaments. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 272 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: EDIT the provided layout-guide image as a STRICT pixel-accurate template, producing ONE standalone top-down JRPG building sprite. Preserve ALL guide architecture coordinates and positions exactly; do not move, enlarge, reduce, or add windows or move the doorway. Output aspect 272:224, preferably 1904 x 1568 displayed pixels, with artwork grid each pixel exactly 7x7 displayed pixels, nearest-neighbor square edges. All original bright magenta background should instead be FULLY TRANSPARENT ALPHA, not pink, without cast shadows or ground. Coordinate system below specifies ART PIXELS (multiply by 7 for the supplied guide). The rectangular roof silhouette exactly x=2..269,y=28..133, with a horizontal split/eave between top roof slope x2..269,y28..74 and lower roof slope x2..269,y77..133; keep the seam at y75-76. Roof occupies all of that rectangular silhouette, seen from ABOVE, including the LOWER BLUE ROOF BLOCK, which is NOT a front wall. Front pale-stone wall is seen straight-on, x=8..263,y=134..223. Ground-level WALKABLE DARK BROWN RECTANGULAR DOOR exactly x=141..162, y=192..223, bottom flush with wall and image bottom; keep an actual door, NOT a window. Keep all seven warm amber windows precisely in guide positions and sizes, with darker brown frames: upper row x44..59, x100..115, x154..169, x210..225 all y148..167; lower row x44..59, x98..113, x210..225 all y192..211. Keep silhouettes of their amber glass within these positions (can depict subtly arched windows INSIDE original rectangular bounding boxes). Do not add windows on roof. Design: large TWO-STOREY academic city inn / scholars' astronomy hall, worn pale ivory stone walls, stone pilasters separating bays, subtle horizontal story course between rows, delicate carved star ornaments between windows, elegant stone Gothic arched window frames with amber-lit glass, blue-slate roof with tidy staggered pixel clusters of shingles, top-left neutral overcast daylight, upper-left warm yellow highlights and rich dusty violet/red shadows, richly colored earthy restrained palette. Roof remains blue-slate across both blocks; upper block slightly lighter than lower. Tasteful small copper flashing or chimney sticking above roof permitted but silhouette and exact roof/wall seam must be retained. Premium modern hi-bit HAND-PLACED PIXEL ART JRPG tile look. Hard-edged solid-color pixel clusters of 3-10 uniform art pixels, 4-6 shades per material. ABSOLUTELY no antialiasing, blur, gradients, speckled noise, dithering, realistic textures, soft shadows, cast shadow, vignette, extra building, text, letters or people. Preserve guide proportions exactly, make details subordinate to the clear shape.
